text:
The rosebush, in its restless way of flowering,

burns through the sap that nourishes its being.

Look at the roses falling from the tree:

there are so many, it will die of this disease!

The rosebush is not grown; its impatient life

consumes itself by flowering before its time.

translation.title: The Rosebush's Restlessness
translation.editorial_note: The botanical allegory retains its feverish expenditure; rosal is varied as bush and tree only where English cadence requires.
